name: alibaba/happy-horse/video-edit
description: Happy Horse Video Edit by Alibaba - AI-powered video editing and transformation. Apply style transfer, motion control, lip-sync, and visual effects to existing videos with natural language instructions.

video.title: Video Url
video.description:
URL of the source video to edit. Formats: MP4, MOV (H.264 recommended). Duration: 3-60 s. Longer side ≤ 2160 px, shorter side ≥ 320 px. Aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1. Frame rate > 8 fps. Max 100 MB. The output video preserves the source aspect ratio. Output duration matches the input video, capped at 15 s (longer inputs are truncated to the first 15 s).

Max file size: 100.0MB, Min duration: 3s, Max duration: 60s, Timeout: 30.0s

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: Recolor the sky to a deep purple sunset.
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired edit. Reference any supplied reference images using @Image1, @Image2, ... up to @Image5. Max 2500 characters.

audio_setting.title: Audio Setting
audio_setting.description: Audio handling. 'auto': model decides whether to regenerate audio. 'origin': preserve the original audio from the input video.

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
reference_image_urls.description: Optional reference images used to guide the edit (up to 5). Formats: JPEG, JPG, PNG, WEBP. Dimensions must be at least 300px. Aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1. Max 10 MB each.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Happy Horse Video Edit

Edit an existing clip with Happy Horse: restyle it, change objects or wardrobe, or rework the scene with an instruction. Optional reference images show the target look; the source motion and length are kept.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text instruction. |
| `video` | video URL, required | — | Source clip, Video 1 in the prompt. |
| `resolution` | `720p` / `1080p` | `720p` | Sets the per-second rate. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `reference_image_urls` | image URL[] | — | Optional reference images for the new look. |
| `audio_setting` | `auto` / `origin` | `auto` | `auto` regenerates audio to match the edit; `origin` keeps the source track. |

## Billing

Alibaba bills the source and the edited output, which are the same length, so each source second bills twice: $0.28 at 720p and $0.48 at 1080p. The quote before submission assumes a 5-second source; the final charge uses the measured length.

| Source clip | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 3s | $0.84 | $1.44 |
| 5s | $1.40 | $2.40 |
| 10s | $2.80 | $4.80 |
| 15s | $4.20 | $7.20 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Lead with the change and say what must stay: “make it a watercolor animation; keep her face and the camera move”.
- Draft at 720p; edits bill twice the source length.

## Limits

- Output length and framing follow the source video.

## Also on SandBase

Other Happy Horse endpoints: `alibaba/happy-horse/text-to-video`, `alibaba/happy-horse/image-to-video`, `alibaba/happy-horse/reference-to-video`, `alibaba/wan/2.7/video-edit` (Wan alternative, bills output only).
